title: pvAdaptiveResampleToImage
body:
## pvAdaptiveResampleToImage

Resamples any dataset onto several image (vtkImageData) blocks, output as a vtkPartitionedDataSet: a k-d tree splits the input points into at least NumberOfImages regions (rounded up to a power of two; 0 means one per MPI process, so one in serial), and each region is sampled with SamplingDimensions points, so densely populated regions get finer spacing. Points outside the input are marked invalid, as with pvResampleToImage. Use it to obtain regular grids of unevenly distributed data for volume rendering or image analysis; use pvResampleToImage for one image over the whole domain.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Each block has its own spacing and origin; do not treat the blocks as one uniform grid.
- The sample count is the number of blocks times the product of SamplingDimensions; 8 blocks of 64 × 64 × 64 already give about 2 million points.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `AdaptiveResampleToImage`. Identity: `filters/AdaptiveResampleToImage`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `NumberOfImages` | Specify the number of partitions to split the dataset into. Set to 0 to indicate that the partitions should match the number of ranks. | `{"minimum":0,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0` |
| `SamplingDimensions` | Number of sample points along x, y and z in each output image block, as [nx, ny, nz]. Every block uses the same counts across its own region's bounds, so the spacing differs between blocks. More points resolve finer detail at a cost proportional to nx × ny × nz per block. | `{"items":{"type":"integer"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |

```json
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvAdaptiveResampleToImage",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
